title: Chapter 13 Plan

parts.title: Plan Payments and Length of Plan
Treatment of Fees and Priority Claims
Vesting of Property of the Estate

notes: Official Form 113 (12/17), the national Chapter 13 plan (Bankruptcy Rule 3015(c)), is published FLAT — no AcroForm at all — so every field claims an `overlay` box the fill engine draws onto an appended content stream, as B2030's do. Boxes were measured from the PDF itself: each text box sits 1.2 pt above the baseline of the printed underscores it fills (pdfplumber's character boxes), and each checkbox box is the square the Wingdings box glyph actually draws (rasterised), grown 1.5 pt a side. The table cells are 7.6-point type, so their boxes carry a `size` (6–9 pt) and are widened to the column's own width where the underscores are shorter than a figure. The exhibit (page 9) is part of the form. `signature_pages` is empty for the reason B2030's is: signature-page selection counts widget pages, and a flat form has none. A district that has replaced this form under Rule 3015.1 is the court registry's fact (insolvia_core/courts.py, `chapter_13_plan`), and packet assembly refuses such a case rather than printing this form.
